findings.title: The M9b.8 selected topology is not executable
findings.evidence: M9b.8 freezes a prospective topology and capacity decision, while the runnable M9b.1 path still selects the historical M9b.0 execution profiles. No connected selected-topology orchestrator exists.

findings.title: The retrieval-only treatment cannot adapt to intermediate evidence
findings.evidence: The frozen authoring grammar exposes only the existing invoke/map/fold/boundedFix algebra and the reference refinement operation appends evidence rather than extracting a bounded value for a later query.

findings.title: M9b.9 can dispatch despite verified NO-GO authority
findings.evidence: The verified report fixes provider and live authority to false, but the lifecycle function does not consume those authority fields before its transport path. Caller-supplied available capacity is therefore not a sufficient authority boundary.

findings.title: Provider output is not bound through evidence, arm persistence, and measurement
findings.evidence: The M9b.10 receipt binds the raw response and output-envelope decision, but there is no selected-topology terminal record that carries the exact request through retrieval evidence, evaluation, accounting settlement, and the new measurement boundary.

findings.title: The frozen 168-pair primary McNemar analysis has no implementation
findings.evidence: Preparation freezes 168 primary pairs and alpha 0.05, while the implemented analysis at the cited measurement boundary is prospective power analysis rather than the exact full-population selected-topology primary test.
